mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust demand environment, which should lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors become more optimistic about future earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 6% indicates a weakening labor market, which should lead to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors become more pessimistic about future earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth is above 2% and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a strong supply environment with low labor costs, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO growth is above 2% and UNRATE is below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts indicates a weakening demand environment, which should lead to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors become more pessimistic about future earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST is declining.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the CPI growth rate is above 2%, it signals an accommodative monetary environment with rising inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above 200,000 indicates a strong labor market, which should lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors become more optimistic about future earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS growth is above 200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth is above 3% and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a strong demand environment with low labor costs, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when RSAFS growth is above 3% and UNRATE is below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
